responses.text: Greetings! I do not believe we have met before. I have the singular distinction of being designated as Bohr.
A pleasure to meet you, sir. What may I do for you?
A pleasure to meet you, madam. What may I do for you?
My, how rude. If you must know, I am here to assist my master Keely in her research.

topics.prompt: Skip the introductions. Why are you here?

responses.text: Why yes, the master was here some time ago. Do you have business with her?

topics.prompt: Have you seen a ghoul named Keely around here?

responses.text: Very well, I'll get back to computing these protein sequences, then. Farewell.

topics.prompt: I don't have time to talk, sorry.

responses.text: I couldn't say, exactly. She went down to the lower levels some time ago and hasn't been back since. Do you suppose something has happened to her?
Oh, thank you! The master can really be a bother sometimes, but she has a good heart.
Now, I must get back to computing protein sequences. Please tell the master to hurry back if you see her.

topics.prompt: Perhaps. I'll go down and look for her.

responses.text: I have been given explicit instructions to stay here until the master returns.

topics.prompt: Why don't you go and look for her?

responses.text: Very little, I'm afraid. I've been stuck here calculating protein sequences for most of our sojourn here thus far.
Master Keely has done most of the exploring. She might be able to tell you more.

topics.prompt: What can you tell me about this place?

responses.text: I am assisting my master Keely with her research. We have been tasked with extracting as much of the research that was performed here as possible.
